earnings_guidance.headline: AMMN reports nine-month 2026 net profit of USD871.46 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Amman Mineral's net sales rose 493.80% year on year to USD3.24 billion, as export and domestic sales increased. The company was removed from the MSCI Global Standard Index at its May 2026 review. Shares fell 4.08% to 3,290 in intraday trading on 4 November.

earnings_guidance.event: Royaltama Mulia Kontraktorindo turns profitable in nine-month 2026 results
earnings_guidance.headline: RMKO turns profitable with Rp1.2 billion 9M net profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Royaltama Mulia Kontraktorindo’s 9M revenue rose 57.4% to Rp345.3 billion, while EBITDA reached Rp59.4 billion from a Rp9.3 billion loss a year earlier. A rights issue completed on 21 July raised Rp114.3 billion, cutting debt-to-equity from 0.54x to 0.19x and financial debt by 40.6% to Rp56.7 billion.

earnings_guidance.headline: FOLK reports Rp18.39 billion nine-month profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Multi Garam swung from a Rp8.27 billion loss in the same period a year earlier, with basic and diluted earnings per share at Rp4.51 versus minus Rp2.10. Net revenue rose to Rp14.45 billion from Rp14.05 billion.

earnings_guidance.headline: BNI raises 2026 loan-growth target to 10%-13%
earnings_guidance.blurb: The new range replaces 8%-10%, with the bank citing adequate lending capacity and resilient client prospects. Finance and Strategy Director Hussein Paolo Kartadjoemena said growth is driven by demand in natural resources and strategic infrastructure, rather than domestic consumption.

market_structure_policy.event: Planned 2027 nickel quota cuts could benefit NCKL and INCO
market_structure_policy.headline: Planned 2027 nickel quota cuts may aid NCKL and INCO amid a 750,000-800,000-ton surplus
market_structure_policy.blurb: Analysts say Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Bahlil Lahadalia's plan could reduce the global nickel surplus and support a price recovery. Trimegah Bangun Persada's integrated mining and processing may cushion higher domestic ore costs, while Vale Indonesia could benefit from a rebound, with energy-cost efficiency key to profitability.

market_structure_policy.event: Mirae projects BRMS and BRPT may leave MSCI Standard Cap Indonesia index
market_structure_policy.headline: Mirae sees 90% BRMS downgrade risk and 40% BRPT deletion risk from MSCI Standard Cap
market_structure_policy.blurb: Mirae’s estimates use price thresholds of Rp440 for Bumi Resources Minerals and Rp1,290 for Barito Pacific during 19–30 October. If both leave the index, estimated passive outflows are Rp300 billion from BRMS and Rp900 billion from BRPT.

deals_control.event: GMFI transfers shares to Danantara as an in-specie dividend
deals_control.headline: GMFI transfers 65.77% stake to Danantara as an in-specie dividend
deals_control.blurb: Garuda Maintenance reported nine-month revenue of US$413 million, up 34.53%, while net profit fell 0.85% to US$22.12 million. Danantara received 82.1 billion Series B shares on 2 November, valued at nominal Rp1.55 trillion, giving it 65.77%; management said ultimate control remains indirectly with the government through BP BUMN.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: GMFI reported nine-month revenue of US$413 million, up 34.53%, and net profit of US$22.12 million, down 0.85%.

deals_control.event: Nawasena agrees to acquire control of Idea Indonesia Akademi
deals_control.headline: Nawasena agrees to acquire 66.58% of IDEA
deals_control.blurb: Nawasena signed a conditional agreement on 2 November to buy 707.32 million Idea Indonesia Akademi shares from Eko Desriyanto and Idea Asia Investama. Completion remains subject to the agreement’s conditions, after which Nawasena must make a mandatory tender offer to public shareholders.

deals_control.event: LAPD shareholders appoint JSI Sinergi Mas as controller and approve capital increase
deals_control.headline: LAPD appoints JSI Sinergi Mas controller with 51% stake, approves capital increase
deals_control.blurb: At its 29 October meeting, shareholders approved raising authorized capital from Rp1.5 trillion to Rp1.6 trillion and a second rights issue with new Series B shares at a nominal Rp25 each. Existing shares will be designated Series A, and Bambang Rahardja Burhan resigned as director effective from the meeting.
